run_pipeline_image2video: run the LTXImageToVideoSTGPipeline to generate a video from a single input image with STG guidance
configure_stg_guidance: configure spatio-temporal guidance (STG) by setting stg_applied_layers_idx and stg_scale parameters in the pipeline call
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts using T5 text encoder with configurable max sequence length and classifier-free guidance
prepare_video_latents: prepare image-to-video latents by encoding the input image and conditioning the first frame with the provided image
denoise_video_latents: denoise video latents through the diffusion loop with optional classifier-free guidance and spatio-temporal guidance
